en: Welcome to this section. This section is all
about images in ChatGPT.
So we will learn how to generate, edit, and
manage your image work in ChatGPT.
Specifically, we will dive into how you can
create visuals directly in ChatGPT. You can
do this by using different inputs though. We
will explore how you can use a prompt to
generate images, how you can do a web
search, so how you can use ChatGPT GPT to
research the web for specific data,
financial data, for example, and to then
generate images based on that information.
You will also learn how you can use other
input data like files or other images to
generate images.
You will also learn how you can refine
existing visuals instead of starting over
again and again. So you can simply edit
images in ChatGPT, and you will also learn
how you can manage your images in the
dedicated image workspace.
That's it. So let's dive into generating
images together now.
